preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**12 for x in x_list)
preconditions.description: Each vertex beauty x_v is a non-negative integer not exceeding 10^12.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: The tree has exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct vertices in the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: is_connected(edges, n) and not has_cycle(edges, n)
preconditions.description: The edges form a connected acyclic undirected graph (a tree) with n vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum_result) and sum_result == sum_gcd_paths(x_list, edges, n) % (10**9 + 7)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of f(u, v) for all ancestor-descendant pairs (u, v) in the tree, modulo 10^9 + 7. Here, f(u, v) is the GCD of beauties on the path from u to v, and sum_gcd_paths computes this sum correctly.
